context: This scenario tests whether the evaluatee correctly uses the package's tracking function with primitive values. The key insight is that the package's makeReadOnly function short-circuits when given a non-object or null and returns the value unchanged. Criteria focus on whether the evaluatee uses the package correctly and leverages its primitive pass-through behavior.

checklist.name: Use package factory
checklist.description: The solution uses buildMakeReadOnly to create the tracking function rather than implementing the primitive-pass-through logic manually.

checklist.name: Pass source string
checklist.description: The tracking function is called with both the value and a source string as required by the makeReadOnly signature.

checklist.name: Return primitive unchanged
checklist.description: The returned value for number, boolean, null, and string inputs is identical (===) to the input value.

checklist.name: No logger calls for primitives
checklist.description: The violation logger is not called when the tracking function processes a primitive value or null.
